components.name: MyDigiRecords Health Wallet
components.description: A patient wallet built by MyDigiRecords: US Core records, an insurance card, and interactive check-in forms. Renders questionnaires and SMART Health Cards. Test patient: Emily Carter, born 1988, with problems, allergies, medications, immunizations, observations, procedures, and an insurance card. From MyDigiRecords.
components.testPatient: Emily Carter, born 1988, with problems, allergies, medications, immunizations, observations, procedures, and an insurance card
components.notes: Use the Try with demo account button to instantly launch the wallet and select which records you want to share.

components.name: MyDigiRecords Health Wallet (Android)
components.description: MyDigiRecords native Android health wallet for SMART Health Check-in, enabling patients to access their health information and share relevant records for check-in.
components.testPatient: Emily Carter, born 1988 — synthetic test patient.
components.notes:
1. Install and open the MyDigiRecords Health Wallet app.
2. Accept the Terms and Conditions.
3. On the login screen, tap **Try with demo account** to automatically sign in to the demo user.
4. Once signed in, initiate the **EHR-initiated check-in flow** to test the SMART Health Check-in experience.

Use the demo account and synthetic patient data for testing.
components.requirements: Android 10 or later with Chrome 141 or later
